Name: Nonaplic's Maru Redesign
Author: Nonaplic
Description:
A redesign of Maru, all portraits and sprites (including normal, winter, beach, hospital, dance, wedding) replaced. I felt her original design was lacking something so I tried adding some new details to make it nicer.
Additionally, if you don't like the freckles I have made an alternate version without them under optional files.

Downloads.Description: If you don't like her freckles, this is an alternate version without them.
